## [1.4.0] - 2026-11-13

### Added
- Carts are saved for logged-out users for 30 days (#211)
- Dark mode for the account page (#217)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Orders endpoint now returns prices in cents (#214)

### Fixed
- Checkout total ignored the discount code on mobile (#213)
- Search box lost focus after the first letter (#215)

### Security
- Password reset links now expire (#219)

## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-20

### Added
- Download invoices as PDF (#301)
- Invite teammates by email (#304)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Remove the deprecated `/v1/customers` endpoint (#305)
- Search results load twice as fast on large catalogues (#308)

### Fixed
- VAT on invoice totals ending in .5 is now rounded correctly (#303)
- Date picker showed the wrong month in Safari (#307)

### Security
- Uploaded files can no longer be read by other accounts (#309)

## [0.9.2] - 2026-12-01

### Breaking Changes
- CLI config file renamed from `.toolrc` to `tool.toml`. Rename existing `.toolrc` files to `tool.toml` to keep your settings. (#41)

### Added
- New `tool doctor` command checks your setup. (#42)

### Fixed
- `--quiet` flag no longer prints warnings. (#40)
- Crash on Windows paths containing spaces. (#45)

### Security
- Upgraded the YAML parser to patch a remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-4411). (#44)

## [3.2.0] - 2026-12-08

### Added
- Offline maps for saved trips (#515)
- Share a trip with a link that expires (#519)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** The trips endpoint returns 50 results per page by default and is paginated (#518)

### Fixed
- Edits made while offline are no longer lost after logging in (#517)
- Map pins no longer overlap on small screens (#521)

### Removed
- Legacy trip importer (#524)

### Security
- Shared links no longer expose the owner's email address (#522)

## [1.11.0] - 2027-01-05

### Added
- Spell check for 14 languages in the editor (#87)
- Export documents as Markdown (#91)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Internet Explorer 11 is no longer supported (#93)

### Fixed
- Undo no longer skips every second change in the editor (#89)
- Tables pasted from Excel keep their borders (#94)

### Security
- Session tokens are no longer written to the browser console (#90)

## [4.0.1] - 2027-01-19

### Added
- Pause a subscription for up to 3 months (#706)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Annual plans now renew on the purchase date instead of the 1st of the month (#702)

### Fixed
- Receipts showing the wrong currency symbol (#703)
- CSV exports cutting off rows after 10,000 (#707)

### Security
- Forged webhooks are now rejected because signatures are verified (#705)

## [1.4.0] - 2026-11-13

### Added
- Carts are saved for logged-out users for 30 days. (#211)
- Dark mode for the account page. (#217)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** The orders endpoint now returns prices in cents instead of decimal currency units. Update any clients that read order prices. (#214)

### Fixed
- Checkout total now applies the discount code on mobile. (#213)
- The search box keeps focus after the first letter is typed. (#215)
- Password reset links now expire. (#219)

## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-20

### Added
- Invoices can be downloaded as PDF (#301).
- Teammates can be invited by email (#304).

### Changed
- **Breaking:** The deprecated `/v1/customers` endpoint has been removed. See Removed below.
- Search results load about twice as fast on large catalogues (#308).
- The build tool has been switched to Vite (#310).
- The README explains the new invoice API (#302).

### Removed
- **Breaking:** The deprecated `/v1/customers` endpoint has been removed (#305). Migrate to the replacement endpoints described in the invoice API docs.

### Fixed
- VAT was rounded the wrong way for totals ending in .5 (#303).
- The date picker showed the wrong month in Safari (#307).

### Security
- Uploaded files could be read by other accounts. Uploads are now restricted to the owning account (#309).

- Security: upgraded the YAML parser to fix a remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-4411). Upgrade promptly. (#44)
